create_bucket: create a new HuggingFace bucket with optional private flag, region, and exist-ok behavior
list_buckets: list all buckets in a namespace or list files inside a specific bucket with tree or recursive output
sync_bucket: sync files between a local directory and a HuggingFace bucket with include/exclude patterns and dry-run support
copy_bucket_files: copy files between local paths and HuggingFace buckets or between two bucket URIs
remove_bucket_files: remove files from a HuggingFace bucket recursively with include/exclude patterns and dry-run preview
